trigger_or_context: After you talk or text, you feel unsure what it really meant.
short_term_function: Reading it again is a way to look for an answer on your own instead of asking.
developmental_cost: You spend time going over old words instead of getting new, real answers. The worry keeps going.
adaptive_alternative_1: When you catch yourself rereading, name the one thing you want to know. Then ask it in plain words, or wait and watch what they do next.
what_new_response_supports: You get a real answer instead of guessing from old words.
expected_discomfort_or_cost: You may have to sit with not knowing for a bit, or hear an answer you don't like.

trigger_or_context: You are waiting to hear back, and you can see when they were last online.
short_term_function: Checking gives you a small piece of info when you don't have a real answer yet.
developmental_cost: You watch their moves instead of getting real answers. The uneasy feeling keeps coming back.
adaptive_alternative_1: When you want to check their online time, stop and notice something real instead: do they reach out to you and follow through? Let that be your answer.
what_new_response_supports: You see if they really show up for you, not just whether they are online.
expected_discomfort_or_cost: You give up the small hit of info. You may have to wait to see what they do.

trigger_or_context: You are not sure you can count on this person, so you set up small tests.
short_term_function: Testing is a way to check if you can count on them without asking straight out.
developmental_cost: Secret tests can give mixed results. The other person doesn't know what you need, so you may not learn the truth.
adaptive_alternative_1: Instead of setting up a test, name one real thing you need. Ask for it in plain words. Then watch, over time, if they come through.
what_new_response_supports: You find out if they can really be counted on, based on real tries, not secret tests.
expected_discomfort_or_cost: You have to say what you need out loud. They might not come through, and that tells you something too.
review_reason: Maintaining call rests on reading 'testing' as hidden tests, not plain observing; candidate-section item with a second cluster, so the framing could shift.
